Marker_RangeRing.channels: band: U around (24 tiles per turn on the mesh), V inner edge (0) to outer edge (1). R crisp rim at V 0.8, G inner glow (0.22 at V 0, continuing Marker_RangeFill) and outer falloff, B one dash per tile (scroll U slowly for a turning dash)

Marker_RangeFill.channels: disc under the band: R soft glow in the outer quarter, rising to 0.22 at the disc rim = the band's inner edge (use the same gain as the band's G so they meet without a seam), G a barely visible flat fill

RangeRing_Band.note: scale XZ by the range; UV2.y 0 inner / 1 outer for a constant-width shader
